feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Clinical Practice Outcomes With Lecanemab for Alzheimer Disease.
drug.zh: 真实世界用lecanemab的早期AD患者中，ARIA发生率及严重不良事件与12个月认知变化被系统评估。

drug.title: From Proof of Principle to Therapeutic Discipline: Strategies to Improve the Benefit/Risk Profile of Amyloid-Targeting Treatments for Alzheimer's Disease.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗已确立疾病修饰地位，但获益/风险窗口狭窄，需通过治疗纪律优化患者选择与安全管理。

drug.title: Anti-Amyloid Antibodies in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease: An Umbrella Review.
drug.zh: Lecanemab与donanemab可延缓认知衰退并清除β淀粉样蛋白，但ARIA风险需权衡。

drug.title: APOE-stratified genome-wide association analyses provide insights into the genetic etiology of Alzheimers's disease.
drug.zh: 按APOE基因型分层全基因组关联分析，揭示AD遗传病因及ε4/ε2效应机制。

drug.title: The path to treating multiple-etiology dementia: Combining vascular risk control and disease-modifying neurodegenerative therapies.
drug.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the A
drug.zh: 多病因痴呆需血管危险控制与抗淀粉样蛋白等神经退行性病修饰治疗联合，单通路研发模式已到尽头。

drug.title: Baseline plasma C1q and C3 as potential biomarkers for lecanemab efficacy and ARIA risk in early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 基线血浆C1q和C3可预测早期阿尔茨海默病中lecanemab的疗效与ARIA风险。

drug.title: In brief: Subcutaneous lecanemab (Leqembi Iqlik) for initial treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
drug.journal: The Medical letter on drugs and therapeu
drug.zh: 皮下仑卡奈单抗用于阿尔茨海默病初始治疗，疗效与静脉给药相当且安全性可控。

drug.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗需警惕脑淀粉样血管病等脑血管共病，其影像异常可模拟卒中并影响再灌注与抗栓决策。

mech.title: Rethinking tau-targeted therapy in Alzheimer's disease: Toward a dual biomarker strategy.
mech.zh: 可溶性p-tau下降未必反映tau靶向治疗有效，需结合p-tau262等特定位点与神经纤维缠结负荷的双生物标志物策略评估。

mech.title: Operationalizing Alzheimer's disease trials in the era of targeted therapies.
mech.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白单抗时代需在试验与队列中记录药物类型、剂量、清除程度及神经退行性下游效应以解读结局。

mech.title: APOE genotypes differentially remodel the astrocytic lipid droplet proteome to shape lipid droplet dynamics.
mech.zh: APOE2/3/4通过重塑星形胶质细胞脂滴蛋白组与脂质组，差异调控脂滴降解动力学。

mech.title: Quercetin-Based Nanotherapeutics for Targeted Drug Delivery in Alzheimer's Disease: Comparative Insights into Molecular Mechanisms, Blood-Brain Barrier Targeting and Therapeutic Perspectives.
mech.zh: 槲皮素纳米递送系统通过多靶点调控AD病理并跨越血脑屏障，可显著改善其脑内生物利用度与治疗潜力。

mech.title: Emerging therapeutic targets beyond amyloid and tau in Alzheimer's Disease: Implications for lifestyle, metabolism and preventive medicine.
mech.zh: AD是多因素疾病，靶向神经炎症、线粒体、自噬及脂代谢等非淀粉样蛋白机制或成防治新方向。

mech.title: Advances in N- and S-Heterocycles as c-Jun-N-Terminal Kinase 3 Inhibitors for Alzheimer's Disease Treatment.
mech.zh: 综述指出N/S杂环骨架可通过选择性抑制JNK3减轻神经炎症与凋亡，SAR研究已优化其成药性。

mech.title: Evaluating the 8-Year Association Between Cognition and Beta Amyloid in the Dallas Lifespan Brain Study Cohort.
mech.zh: 8年追踪显示， Aβ阳性与阴性者的情景记忆、工作记忆、加工速度和推理衰退无显著差异，不支持Aβ单独驱动认知下降。

mech.title: Enhancing Alzheimer's disease diagnosis in primary care through targeted screening of people at risk of developing dementia - study design and feasibility assessment of the PREDEM primary care study.
mech.zh: PREDEM初级保健研究证实，联合数字认知测试与血液标志物靶向筛查高危人群，在基层早期检出阿尔茨海默病可行。

dx.title: Rethinking tau-targeted therapy in Alzheimer's disease: Toward a dual biomarker strategy.
dx.zh: 可溶性p-tau下降未必反映tau靶向治疗有效，需结合p-tau262等特定位点与神经纤维缠结负荷的双生物标志物策略评估。

dx.title: Validation of plasma core biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease: A multicenter study in usual practice conditions.
dx.zh: 真实临床条件下血浆p-tau217/Aβ42诊断AD的效能最优，且受共病与用药影响小。

dx.title: Enhancing Alzheimer's disease diagnosis in primary care through targeted screening of people at risk of developing dementia - study design and feasibility assessment of the PREDEM primary care study.
dx.zh: PREDEM初级保健研究证实，联合数字认知测试与血液标志物靶向筛查高风险人群，在基层早期检出阿尔茨海默病可行。

dx.title: Regional juxtacortical microstructural changes and gene expression provide insights into neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: AD患者近皮层自由水升高与特定基因表达及胶质细胞富集区域的空间对应揭示白质微结构退变的分子基础。

dx.title: Digital cognitive phenotyping enhances risk stratification in preclinical Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 数字认知表型可分四型，在Aβ阳性者中识别出认知衰退高风险亚群，提升临床前AD风险分层精度。

dx.title: Plasma Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein and Neurofilament Light Chain Concentrations Are Inversely Associated with Retinal Microvascular Perfusion and Vessel Density in Cognitively Normal Individuals with Familial or Genetic Risk Factors for Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 认知正常但具阿尔茨海默病家族或遗传风险者中，血浆GFAP和NfL越高，视网膜微血管灌注与血管密度越低。

dx.title: Plasma p-Tau217 and SPECT-Based eZIS in Mild Cognitive Impairment: Concordance Analysis with Validation in an Amyloid PET Sub-Cohort.
dx.zh: 血浆p-Tau217与eZIS在MCI中显著相关，且淀粉样PET亚组验证支持其反映AD病理。

dx.title: Real-world anti-amyloid therapy beyond traditional symptomatic populations: a longitudinal case series.
dx.zh: 真实世界三例抗淀粉样蛋白治疗显示，临床与生物标志物轨迹因基线特征及治疗时机而异。

prev.title: β-Amyloid and Glutathione Dysregulation Cooperatively Drive Lipid Peroxidation and Ferroptosis in Neuron-Like Cells.
prev.zh: Aβ与谷胱甘肽耗竭协同驱动神经元样细胞脂质过氧化和铁死亡。

prev.title: Adiposity and Cognitive Performance in Older Men and Women from the Study of Muscle, Mobility and Aging (SOMMA).
prev.journal: The journals of gerontology. Series A, B
prev.zh: 健康老年人内脏脂肪越高，处理速度与执行功能越差，但整体认知筛查无显著关联。

prev.title: Time to diagnosis in FTLD-associated syndromes in Latin America.
prev.zh: 拉丁美洲FTLD患者平均确诊延迟约3年，行为变异型及低教育水平者延迟更长。

prev.title: Non-Pharmacological Interventions for Cognitive Function Management in Middle-Aged and Older Adults with Hypertension: A Scoping Review.
prev.zh: 现有证据提示运动、生活方式、睡眠及认知康复等非药物干预或可同时改善中年及老年高血压患者的血压与认知功能，但证据仍待充实。

prev.title: Effects of long-term daily supplementation with vitamin D3 and marine omega-3 fatty acids on change in ADRD biomarkers: A secondary analysis of a randomized clinical trial.
prev.zh: 长期补充维生素D3和omega-3均未显著改变NT1、Aβ40:42、NfL或GFAP等ADRD血液生物标志物的纵向变化。

prev.title: Effect of choline supplementation in presymptomatic APOE ε4 carriers: a pilot study.
prev.zh: 症状前APOE ε4携带者补充胆碱可改善脂代谢相关生物标志物，但尚需更大规模验证。

prev.title: Capillary blood sampling in neurodegenerative diseases - the future for screening and monitoring brain health?
prev.zh: 指尖采血微样本（DPS/UAD）检测pTau-217、NfL和GFAP与静脉血浆或脑脊液高度相关，有望用于神经退行性疾病的筛查与监测。

prev.title: Evaluating the 8-Year Association Between Cognition and Beta Amyloid in the Dallas Lifespan Brain Study Cohort.
prev.zh: 8年追踪显示，淀粉样蛋白阳性与阴性者的情景记忆、工作记忆、加工速度和推理衰退无显著差异。

intro.title: Unlocking the Potential of Isatin Scaffolds in Acetylcholinesterase Inhibition.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲一种叫靛红的小分子可能帮阿尔茨海默病人保住大脑里传递记忆的化学信使，让外行知道它或许能变成新药方向。

intro.title: A new era of genome-wide association studies in the field of Alzheimer's disease and overlapping co-pathologies: lessons learned from a neuropathology-centered approach.
intro.zh: 这篇综述说，科学家正用大脑尸检的病理结果代替临床诊断来做基因研究，帮我们更准地找到老年痴呆的真正病因，推动新药研发。

intro.title: Caenorhabditis elegans as a Model for Studying Nrf2/SKN-1 Activation in Alzheimer's Disease: Plant Bioactive Compounds and Therapeutic Translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是：科学家用一种叫线虫的小虫子，研究某些植物里的天然成分能不能激活人体自身的抗氧化开关，从而帮我们对抗老年痴呆。

intro.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
intro.zh: 抽血用电脑算一算，就能提前挑出脑子里已悄悄长斑块、适合参加阿尔茨海默病新药试验的人，省去昂贵扫描和腰穿。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆可能是一根藤上的两个瓜，控好血糖、护好大脑，或许能帮我们老得慢一点、糊涂得晚一点。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 治阿尔茨海默病的新药虽能清脑内淀粉样蛋白，却可能让脑血管变脆、引发脑水肿或微出血，这篇综述提醒普通人：有脑血管问题的人用这类药要格外小心。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用人的干细胞在培养皿里养出脑内免疫细胞，想弄清它们怎么把阿尔茨海默病越搞越糟，帮我们找新药。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 抽血查几种脑相关蛋白，用简易电子传感器就能早期发现阿尔茨海默病，便宜又不遭罪，方便大伙儿筛查。
